physical_completion.completion_goal_method: Engineering approach progress from spawn to requested rest station; legal classification separate.

statutory_text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: On the highway side of any vehicle stopped or parked at the edge of or curb of a highway.
